name: Adniel
description: Adniel can craft and upgrade Errtel items! She can also add and upgrade +Elemental Wing Option on Tier 4 Wings & Capes!

name: Angela The Supplier
description: Angela The Supplier offers general items for sale including health potions, mana potions, Arrows and Bolts, Town Portal Scroll, Armor of Guardsman, and other miscellaneous items.

name: Apostle Devin
description: Apostle Devin is searching for a mighty warrior to accept a very difficult quest. Ultimately, he plans to infiltrate Balgass' Barracks and kill the evil war lord, Dark Elf, that lurks within! It will not be an easy task. Agree to help him and he will bless you with special abilities.

name: Arena Guard
description: Arena Guard offers general items for sale including health potions, mana potions, Arrows and Bolts, Town Portal Scroll, Armor of Guardsman, and other miscellaneous items.

name: Captain Slough
description: Captain Slough will warp you to Acheron in exchange for a Spirit Map item.

name: Caren The Barmaid
description: Caren The Barmaid sells Ale, Town Portal Scroll, Armor of Guardsman, Sphere, and several mini-game ticket crafting items.

name: Chaos Card Master
description: In previous versions, this NPC was used as a loot box system. Players could purchase a Choas Card item on the web item shop and exchange it with this NPC to recieve an item. Essentially, it used the in-game crafting system to create a loot box system.

name: Chaos Goblin Machine
description: Located in Noria, the Chaos Goblin Machine is used for crafting and upgrading items! The machine, which is managed by Goblins, is entirely powered with Jewels of Chaos. The machine is an ancient construction which converts jewels in order to manipulate, combine, and craft entirely new items! However, the technology isn't necessarily stable, and therefore it can occasionally destroy items during a combination. Either way, it will be one of the most useful NPCs in the game!

name: Charon
description: Charon offers entry into the Devil Square mini-game. Speak with him in Event Square in order to enter! However, you'll need to craft a Devil Square Invitation to enter!

name: David
description: In previous versions, this NPC was used to exchange Lucky Ticket items. Players could purchase a Lucky Ticket item on the web item shop and exchange it with this NPC to recieve an item. Essentially, it used the in-game crafting system to create a loot box system.

name: Deruvish
description: Deruvish, a member of Vanert, has studied Acheron in much detail and has discovered how the monster's elemental abilities work. Speak with him to learn the basics of elemental monsters and how you can fight them successfully!

name: Doorkeeper Titus
description: Doorkeeper Titus, is the manager of the Colosseum. The Colossem is a duel arena where friendly PVP combat can take place. You can also watch any on-going duels by speaking with him.

name: Elf Lala
description: Elf Lala offers general recovery items and some equipment for low level Fairy Elf class. Items for sale include armor items, skill items, potions, arrows\bolts, Town Portal Scroll, Armor of Guardsman, and other general items.

name: Elpis
description: Elpis manages the Refinery Tower, which is used to refine impure Gemstone into Jewel of Harmony! However, the Refinery Tower gets invaded by Nightmare and his minons regularly, whom block the path to Elpis! Therefore, you'll have to fight you way through the hoard of monsters in order to reach Elpis and use the Refinery Tower.

name: Gallus The Elder
description: Gallus The Elder sells items for the Fairy Elf class. Items for sale include armor, bows, crossbows, a quiver, and a shield.

name: Gens Duprian Steward
description: Gregory, a Gens Steward, represents the Duprian family. A Gens is essentially a clan. The Duprian family is descendant from one of the most noble bloodlines in Mu. The family is lead by a high ranking knight named Winston.

name: Gens Vanert Steward
description: Conrad, a Gens Steward, represents the Vanert family. A Gens is essentially a clan. The Vanert family led by a well known socialite, Reicht. He strives put a stop to Winston. Reicht believes Winston's goal is an absolute rule over the Mu empire.

name: Guard
description: In previous versions, this NPC was used to combat players with a PK Status. If a players had a murderer PK Status, the NPC would attack the player on sight! This NPC cannot be attacked.

name: Guardsman
description: You can register for Castle Seige by speaking with the Guardsman. He is located in the Valley of Loren, but can also be found in Crywolf if the server successfully defended the Crywolf Invasion.

name: Hanzo The Blacksmith
description: Hanzo The Blacksmith sells shields and weapons. He is located in Lorencia, but you can also find him in Crywolf. Of course, he will only appear in Crywolf if the server successfully defended the Crywolf Invasion.

name: Jerint The Assistant
description: In previous versions, this NPC was used to enter the Imperial Guardian's Fortress mini-game. However, Imperial Guardian's Fortress is now also discontinued.

name: Jin
description: Jin sells general items like potions, arrows/bolts, Town Portal Scroll, Armor of Guardsman, and other miscellaneous things.

name: Lahap
description: Lahap only appears during the Elemental Symbols Events. He will give you an Element Box in exchange for Elemental Symbols. He is located in Elveland and also appears in Crywolf if the server successfully defended the Crywolf Invasion.

name: Leina The Merchant
description: Leina The Merchant sells general items like potions, arrows/bolts, Town Portal Scroll, Armor of Guardsman, and other miscellaneous things.

name: Lumen The Barmaid
description: Lumen The Barmaid sells Ale, Town Portal Scroll, Armor of Guardsman, Sphere, and all the mini-game ticket crafting items you could ever need!

name: Marce
description: Marce sells various skill items that can be used by the Summoner, Dark Wizard, or Magic Gladiator.

name: Marlon
description: Marlon is a loyal guard whom works for the Church of Devias, assisting as a guard in various cities. He offers Quests for the Blade Knight, Muse Elf, Soul Master, and Bloody Summoner Character Classes. Agree to help Marlon and he will bless you with special abilities.

name: Mercenary Guild Manager Tercia
description: In previous versions, this NPC offered the Daily Quests. The quests could be completed once per day and the task of the quest changed each day. A daily quests system still exist, but now you simply accept these quests directly from the Quest Menu.

name: Messenger Of Archangel
description: Messenger Of Archangel offers entry into the Blood Castle Mini-game. Speak with him in Event Square in order to enter the Mini-game!

name: Monica
description: Monica sells Muun Evolution Stones in exchange for Wizardry Stones. Her store stock changes every Egg of Monsters event, but she always sells the Evolution Stone for Repen, Pon, and Griffs.

name: Moss
description: Moss is a famous gambler in Mu, offering a sort of gambling service to Muitizens. He will sell you a Gambling Box, containing one random item, in exchange for a certain type of currency. The item may or may not be something special however, there is a chance to get something exclusive from these boxes!

name: Natasha Firecracker Merchant
description: Natasha sells Firecrackers! Throw them on the ground to celebrate!

name: Oracle Layla
description: Layla sells general items like potions, arrows/bolts, Town Portal Scroll, Armor of Guardsman, and other miscellaneous things.

name: Osbourne & Jerridon
description: Osbourne and Jerridon can add, reroll, and remove '+Jewel of Harmony Option' on items! They also know how to craft 'Refining Stones.'

name: Pamela The Supplier
description: Pamela sells general items like potions, arrows/bolts, Town Portal Scroll, Armor of Guardsman, and other miscellaneous things.

name: Pasi The Mage
description: Pasi The Mage sells various skill items and some equipment items for the Dark Wizard or Magic Gladiator.

name: Potion Girl Amy
description: Amy sells general items like potions, arrows/bolts, Town Portal Scroll, Armor of Guardsman, and other miscellaneous things.

name: Priest James
description: Priest James owns an item shop with various Mastery items for sale like equipment, Skill Items, Boss Room items, and high level crafting ingredients. Everything in his shop is only sold in exchange for Ruud.

name: Priestess Veina
description: Priestess Veina has put in a request to the Mercenary Guild, looking for an adventurer to complete a task. The Quests are offered on Monday and Thursday to characters that are at least Character Level Level 350. Speak with the Mercenary Guild Manager in order to start the Quests.

name: Rhea
description: Rhea sells basic armor and weapons for the Summoner character class.

name: Royal Guard Captain Lorence
description: Royal Guard Captain Lorence allows experienced players to create an official Guild! A Guild is a groups of players which support each other as a small community. There are many Mini-games which involve Guild participation, and therefore being part of a strong Guild can be very rewarding!

name: Safety Guardian
description: Safety Guardian is a safe storage area where you can store valuable goods for a small Zen fee. This NPC is also known as the Vault.

name: Sebina The Priest
description: Sebina The Priest is a great priestess of the Church of Devias. She has a couple Quests to offer Tier 1 Character Class adventurers. Speak with her, after you have reached Character Level Level 150, to start the Quest!

name: Seed Master
description: The Seed Master is the expert of Socket Items! He can craft Seeds, Seed Spheres, and better Socket Items for you, and can also apply or unsocket Seed Spheres! He is a very knowledgable guy!

name: Sent
description: Sent is a female knight with a graceful figure. She is one of the 12 Priests of Light, which is a guardian knight serving the sacred god Lugard. Carrying out the duties as Lugard's Guardian Knight in many places, she now seeks heroic adventurers to test their ability in order to earn Lugard's blessing. She will pass down her knowledgable power and skill to those that can prove their might. She will only test a player's strength if they have already completed the Master Quest.

name: Shadow Phantom Soldier
description: Shadow Phantom Soldiers are located throughout the continent. These soldiers have been trying to hold off the evil monsters being summoned by Kundun. Shadow Phantom Soldiers, for the last 2 years, have successfully maintained a few cities. Unfortunately, their now diminished forces are not strong enough to do it alone. They are recruiting almost anyone left on the continent to help fight off Kundun's evil. By completing their Quests, the Shadow Phantom Soldiers will guide you to become a great and knowledgable warrior; they will also grant handsome rewards!

name: Silvia
description: Silvia sells general items like potions, arrows/bolts, Town Portal Scroll, Armor of Guardsman, and other miscellaneous things.

name: Sir Lesnar
description: Speak with Sir Lesnar to enter Arka War or Protector of Acheron.

name: Trainer
description: The Trainer NPC can be used to create the Dark Raven and Dark Horse for the Dark Lord class. She also specializes with Guardian mount items, offering crafting, upgrade, and transformation services for those high-level mount items. She is located in Lorencia, but you can also find her in Crywolf. Of course, she will only appear in Crywolf if the server successfully defended the Crywolf Invasion.

name: Wandering Merchant Alex
description: Alex sells skill items and basic equipment items for thee Grow Lancer character class.

name: Wandering Merchant Herald
description: Herald sells armor items for the Dark Knight, Dark Lord, and Magic Gladiator character classes.

name: Wandering Merchant Martin
description: Martin sells general items like potions, arrows/bolts, Town Portal Scroll, and Armor of Guardsman. He, of course, will only appear in Crywolf if the server successfully defended the Crywolf Invasion.

name: Wandering Merchant Zyro
description: Wandering Merchant Zyro has put in a request to the Mercenary Guild, looking for an adventurer to complete a task. The Quests are offered on Tuesday and Friday to characters that are at least Character Level Level 350. Speak with the Mercenary Guild Manager in order to start the Quests.

name: Weapons Merchant Bolo
description: Bolo sells mid-level weapon items for various classes. He also sells the Pandora's Pick item, used in Bless Mining.

name: Weapons Merchant Sophia
description: Sophia sells mid-level equipment items for various character classes.

name: Werewolf Guardsman
description: The Werewold Guardsman blocks the entrance to the Balgass Barracks map. He'll only allow players into Balgass Barracks during and after the 3rd Class Upgrade quest.

name: Wizard Izabel
description: Izabel sells equipment items for the Dark Wizard and Magic Gladiator, and sells various general items.
